base_policy: construct:83:1:K scans successive polynomial x words and retains first K distinct cofactor-projected signed-Frobenius orbits; K900 is a prefix of K1200, which is a prefix of K1271
capacity_selection: K1271 has source-level maximum 83*K*K=134081603 states, so four times this count fits 2^29 packed slots; K1272 crosses to 2^30. K1200 is a predeclared intermediate and fallback if K1271 is resource-censored.
index_mode: KIC_PACKED_ROOT_TABLE=1; one u128 key-and-witness slot; exact 34-bit witness at n=83,K=900
measurement_boundary: IC online starts after target-independent base, normal basis, root index, rank and log solution; includes one public target query, PDP, relation check, descent and scalar replay. Rho online includes Q validation, Q-dependent starts, walk, collision and scalar replay after G-only preparation. Full process and preparation are separate.
qualification: Fifth frozen public-point capacity screen compares packed K900, K1271, and K1200 under one 12 GiB sampled RSS cap. All dispositions are retained. CPU-only shared-host timings are exploratory; controlled wall-time speedup requires Tier 1 or Tier 0 host receipts.
stop_rule: Retain every row, including cap, memory stop, crash, and unverified answer. Compute paired online and cold costs only from verified complete arms. Treat local shared-host timings as exploratory.
